title: A website or app isn't working right
summary: A page shows "Aw, Snap!", won't finish loading, or an app keeps crashing.

steps.title: Reload the page or app
instructions: For a website, press the Refresh key (the circle arrow on the top row).
For an app, close it and open it again.
steps.warning: If the page says the website is blocked, it is blocked on purpose. Do not try to get around it. If you need it for class, tell your teacher.
steps.question: Is it working now?

steps.title: Check other websites
instructions: Try two other websites you use often.
steps.question: Do other websites load?

steps.title: Close extra tabs and apps
instructions: Close tabs and apps you aren't using right now.
Go back to the website or app and try again.
steps.question: Is it working now?

steps.title: Turn it off and on again
instructions: Press and hold the power button until the screen goes dark.
Wait 10 seconds, then press the power button once to turn it back on.
Sign in and try the website or app again.
steps.question: Is it working now?

steps.title: Is it one app, or many?
instructions: Think about where the problem happens.
Is it only one website or app, or do many websites and apps keep crashing?
steps.question: Does it happen in many websites or apps, not just one?
